## Pull request overview

This PR updates Studio’s API console discovery hook to generate endpoint entries for enabled backend services using the `/api/v1/discovery` response, backed by a static service endpoint catalog and a helper to build per-service endpoint definitions. It also removes an invalid Vercel `functions.runtime` configuration and documents the changes in the Studio changelog.

**Changes:**
- Add `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG` + `buildServiceEndpoints()` and use discovery `services`/`routes` to populate API console endpoints for enabled services.
- Update group sort ordering so service groups appear between Auth and Metadata.
- Add Vitest coverage for the catalog/builder and remove invalid Vercel runtime config; update Studio CHANGELOG.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/studio/src/hooks/use-api-discovery.ts | Introduces service endpoint catalog + builder and uses discovery `services`/`routes` to populate API console endpoints and reorder groups. |
| apps/studio/test/service-endpoint-catalog.test.ts | Adds unit tests validating catalog contents and endpoint builder behavior. |
| apps/studio/vercel.json | Removes `functions.runtime` config so Vercel auto-detects the bundled Node function. |
| apps/studio/CHANGELOG.md | Documents the API console discovery enhancement and the Vercel config fix under Unreleased. |

`storage` endpoints will never be added with the current enable-check, because the discovery `services` map uses the CoreServiceName key `file-storage` (see `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` where `services['file-storage']` is emitted), but the catalog key here is `storage`. As a result, `discoveredServices[serviceName]` is undefined and `isEnabled` stays false. Consider adding an alias (e.g., resolve `storage` → `file-storage`) or adding a `file-storage` catalog entry and mapping it to the "Storage" group so storage endpoints show up when file storage is enabled.

The Storage endpoint definitions here don’t match the currently implemented runtime storage routes. In `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts`, storage supports `POST /api/v1/storage/upload` and `GET /api/v1/storage/file/:id` (no `GET /:fileId` and no delete), while this catalog advertises `GET /:fileId` and `DELETE /:fileId`. This will lead to 404s/misleading API console entries; please align the catalog paths/methods with the actual storage API (or with the spec’s StorageApiContracts if that’s the intended source of truth).
```suggestion
      { method: 'GET', path: '/file/:id', desc: 'Download file by ID' },
```

The AI endpoints listed here include `/nlq`, `/suggest`, and `/insights`, but the current AI REST routes implementation (`packages/services/service-ai/src/routes/ai-routes.ts`) only defines `/chat`, `/chat/stream`, `/complete`, `/models`, and the `/conversations` endpoints. Advertising non-existent endpoints in the API console will lead to 404s/confusion; please either remove these entries or update the server routes/spec so discovery + catalog stay in sync.


This test asserts AI catalog paths like `/nlq`, `/suggest`, and `/insights`, but those routes don’t exist in the current AI REST implementation (`packages/services/service-ai/src/routes/ai-routes.ts` only includes chat/stream/complete/models and conversations). Keeping these expectations will lock in incorrect API console entries; please update the expected paths to match the actual server routes (or update the server/spec if these endpoints are intended).
